scores.evidence: Pipeline templates, admission policy, registry policy | Trust-model default and sign-off (V1)
scores.rationale: Explicit dependency map and phases ordered trust → substrate → migration → decommission, each gated by a validation before dependents are specified.

scores.evidence: One real commit to one low-criticality, real pilot service goes through the new path to production.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end prod path including deploy, observability and rollback, before features.

scores.evidence: Keyless signing (cosign/Sigstore)... Flip condition: V1 or V2 fails, or external transparency logs are not permitted → KMS-backed keys
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions have reversibility class, default, assumption, validation and flip condition up front.

scores.evidence: Phase 1 — Trust and contract foundation (widest rework first); Wave D: tier-1 services, last.
scores.rationale: Shared trust/template work precedes leaf work, and migration goes smallest exposure first, within phases.

scores.evidence: | 0 | Pilot-scoped deploy rights, secret masking, allow-listed flag |
scores.rationale: Security has concrete treatment in every phase from Phase 0 through decommissioning.

scores.evidence: OpenTelemetry trace spans per pipeline stage, linked to the deployment. Secret-masked logs. Alerts on pipeline failure and failed sync.
scores.rationale: Observability is in Phase 0 and concretely in every later phase.

scores.evidence: Platform infrastructure is Terraform in Git... Pinned template versions, immutable image tags
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed in each phase: IaC, pinned templates and tags, runner images from code, config repo as state, archived config.

scores.evidence: Admission can revert to audit mode; Per-service flag rollback; waves paused on regression
scores.rationale: Failure handling and rollback appear in every phase, starting with Phase 0 rollback and fallback.
Plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Multi-region platform HA: pulled forward when the RTO input requires it, or when the Phase 2 drill shows a regional outage would block hotfixes.
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed each with a concrete pull-forward condition.

note: Very strong, well-grounded plan; all dimensions met with concrete content, with minor gaps only in unresolved UNKNOWN inputs that are explicitly gated.
